name: Pellucid BioSeal Spire Surgical Theater Full Rig
description: Immaculate pearl-white surgical ensemble with biosynthetic scrubs that self-sterilize via embedded UV-pulse fibers, paired with a floor-length sterile overcoat that seals at every seam. The integrated HUD visor is a slim titanium band across the eyes displaying live biometrics, aug-interface overlays, and sub-millimeter AR guidance reticles. Haptic-feedback gloves in translucent bioskin register tissue resistance in real time. Mag-lock clogs in antimicrobial ceramic white complete the look, and a slim sternum harness holds micro-tool cassettes no larger than a credit chip.
functionality: Self-sterilizing fibers maintain Class-1 sterile field; haptic gloves transmit live tissue-feedback data directly to surgeon's BCI during augmentation or gene-mod procedures.
what_it_says: This surgeon operates at the intersection of art and engineering, and the corponation paying their contract expects nothing short of perfection.
story_hooks: The HUD visor still has a ghost overlay from the last patient's neural map — someone whose file has since been classified.
The self-sterilize cycle failed mid-procedure once; the surgeon hasn't reported it and the harness carries a hidden backup scalpel.
related_entities: Arcturus Defense Solutions Proprioceptive Lattice Sleeve

physical_description.visual_profile: A pristine, almost ethereal medical ensemble that reads as high-end surgical authority. Pearl-white dominates with minimal accent, creating an almost sterile, futuristic aesthetic. The floor-length overcoat drapes with architectural precision, while the fitted scrubs underneath suggest both mobility and containment. The titanium HUD visor catches light like a thin metallic stroke across the eyes. Overall impression: a Tier 1 medical elite—someone who commands biotech spaces.
physical_description.fit: Precision-tailored compression fit through the torso and limbs with strategic articulation points at shoulders, elbows, and knees. The overcoat is loose but controlled, sealed at every seam with no billowing. The sternum harness cinches subtly without restricting breath. Designed for sustained surgical stance—upright, composed, immobile when needed.
physical_description.primary_material: Biosynthetic scrub fabric with embedded UV-pulse fiber arrays; self-sterilizing overcoat in sealed ballistic weave composite; translucent bioskin gloves; antimicrobial ceramic for clogs; titanium and smart-glass hybrid for visor band.
physical_description.texture: Scrubs have a soft, almost liquid sheen from the UV fibers, smooth to the touch but subtly quilted in relief patterns. Overcoat is smooth on the exterior but reinforced internally—feels substantial and weightless simultaneously. Gloves are translucent and skin-like, slightly tacky. Ceramic clogs are glossy and impeccable. Visor band is cold, surgical-grade smooth.
physical_description.color_scheme: Dominant pearl-white throughout, with matte titanium gray accents on the visor and sternum harness. Translucent bioskin gloves add a barely-there flesh tone. Antimicrobial ceramic clogs are pristine white with faint iridescent sheen. No patterns—pure clinical minimalism.
physical_description.closures: Magnetic snap closures on the overcoat seams for rapid seal/unseal; friction-fit haptic gloves that adhere to wrist; mag-lock micro-cassettes on sternum harness; slip-on magnetic clogs with auto-grip soles.
distinctive_features: Embedded UV-pulse fiber network visible as faint luminescent lines when activated
Integrated HUD visor as slim titanium band displaying live biometric overlays and AR guidance
Sealed seams on overcoat for sterile environments
Haptic-feedback gloves that register tissue resistance in real time
Micro-tool cassettes on sternum harness (credit-card sized)
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 1 luxury—this is the uniform of high-grade surgical specialists, corpo medical divisions, and premium biotech augmentation clinics. The price tag alone marks exclusivity.
physical_description.cultural_context: The wearer is a medical authority figure—surgeon, biotech specialist, augmentation technician, or elite clinic administrator. Wearing this signals deep corpo integration, access to cutting-edge biotech, and professional credibility in the highest circles. It's a status marker as much as protective gear.
physical_description.condition_typical: Always immaculate. The self-sterilizing system and sealed construction mean this outfit resists weathering. Typical wear shows only microscopic use—perhaps faint handling marks on the visor or gloves from extended surgical sessions, but nothing visible to the casual observer. It's meant to stay pristine.
